question: The Grand Cross of the Order of Honor was conferred on _____ in August 2023.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Prime Minister Narendra Modi**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In August 2023, Prime Minister Narendra Modi was conferred with the Grand Cross of the Order of Honor by the President of Greece, Katerina Sakellaropoulou.
 
• This prestigious honor was given to him in recognition of his efforts to strengthen India-Greece relations and his leadership on the global stage.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• President Draupadi Murmu:
 
• Draupadi Murmu is the 14th President of India, assuming office on July 25, 2022.
 
• She is the first tribal woman to hold the office of President in India. Before becoming President, she served as the Governor of Jharkhand and has been a member of the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP).
 
• Her presidency represents a historic moment, particularly for tribal communities in India, symbolizing the government's recognition of their contributions to society.
 
• Foreign Minister S. Jaishankar:
 
• Subrahmanyam Jaishankar, known as S. Jaishankar, is the current Minister of External Affairs in India, having taken office in May 2019.
 
• A former diplomat, Jaishankar served as India’s Ambassador to the United States and China before entering politics.
 
• He is known for his diplomatic acumen and has been instrumental in strengthening India’s global ties, particularly in areas like defense, trade, and climate change.
 
• Home Minister Amit Shah:
 
• Amit Shah is a senior leader of the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) and serves as the Minister of Home Affairs in India.
 
• He has been one of the key figures in shaping India’s internal security policies and handling significant political issues. Shah has played a major role in the government's legislative initiatives and is considered one of Prime Minister Modi’s closest allies.
 
• He has also been instrumental in the BJP's electoral successes across various states.
